content: Hello, I am Lattice Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Avery Shaw?
Yes, this is Avery Shaw speaking.
First, I need to ask you two security questions. What is your postcode?
What is your year of birth?

I am calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your personal loan has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amounts on all of these products today?
No, I can't. I lost my job yesterday, so my usual salary isn't coming and I can't promise payments the way I used to. I'd be glad to talk with someone from support about it.
I am very sorry to hear that. I am connecting you with a colleague now. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
